summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, providing notices of shareholder meetings and proxy materials. The filing addresses proposals to increase voting rights of Class B ordinary shares from 35 to 100 votes per share and adopt amended articles. This is a routine corporate governance matter involving shareholder votes, with a voting deadline of July 2, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present. The registrant simply reports proxy materials as required for foreign private issuers. The filing is not a special-situation event.
